name: ISO 15189
full_name: Medical laboratories — Requirements for quality and competence
notes: Accreditation standard for medical testing laboratories; required for clinical lab partners

name: CE-IVD
full_name: CE Marking for In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices
notes: Under EU IVDR (Regulation (EU) 2017/746); required for IVD devices sold in EU market

name: Rilibäk
full_name: Richtlinie der Bundesärztekammer zur Qualitätssicherung laboratoriumsmedizinischer Untersuchungen
notes: German national guideline for quality assurance in laboratory medicine; mandatory for German clinical labs

name: GDPR
notes: Regulation (EU) 2016/679; governs processing of personal data including health data (special category)

name: BSI C5
issuer: BSI (Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik)
notes: German federal cloud security certification; required for sensitive health data infrastructure in Germany

name: MDR
notes: Regulation (EU) 2017/745; covers software as a medical device (SaMD) including clinical decision support tools

name: HIPAA
full_name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
issuer: US Department of Health and Human Services
notes: US federal law governing protected health information (PHI); required for healthcare software operating in the US

name: SOC 2 Type II
notes: Third-party audit of security controls; widely required by US healthcare buyers and SaaS vendors

name: ISO 27001
notes: International standard for information security management; often required alongside SOC 2 for EU healthcare vendors

name: DiGA
issuer: BfArM (Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices)
notes: German fast-track pathway for reimbursable digital health apps (prescription apps); requires CE marking + data protection assessment

name: IVDR
notes: Regulation (EU) 2017/746; supersedes the old IVDD; phased rollout through 2027

name: NIS2
notes: Directive (EU) 2022/2555; raises cybersecurity obligations for health sector operators; transposed into national law by Oct 2024

name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015
full_name: Code of practice for information security controls for cloud services
notes: Extends ISO 27001/27002 with cloud-specific controls; commonly required by EU health cloud vendors alongside ISO 27001

name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019
full_name: Code of practice for protection of PII in public clouds
notes: Addresses processing of personally identifiable information (PII) including health data in public cloud environments; complements GDPR compliance

name: ISO 9001:2015
notes: International standard for quality management systems; widely held by healthcare software and services vendors as baseline quality certification

name: TTDSG
notes: German law governing cookie consent and device data access; supplements GDPR for telemedia and telecommunications services in Germany

name: BDSG
notes: German national implementation of GDPR; adds national provisions e.g. § 26 for employee data processing; applies alongside GDPR

name: SCC
notes: EU Commission-approved contractual clauses enabling lawful personal data transfers to third countries (e.g. US-based processors); required when no adequacy decision exists

name: EU-US DPF
notes: Replaced Privacy Shield in July 2023; allows EU personal data transfers to certified US organisations; relevant for health software using US cloud processors (AWS
